description: Daily supply and demand operations dataset by market. Includes demand, booked jobs, completed jobs, utilization, available slots, diagnostics, warranty checks, and service calls. Best for analyzing market-level supply-demand balance,capacity, utilization, and operational constraints.

Daily channel-by-market KPI dataset containing Month, Week, Day, market, and Channel Category dimensions, with core performance metrics including leads, jobs booked, canceled jobs, revenue, and jobs completed. Use this dataset to analyze daily lead volume, booking volume, cancellations, completed jobs, and revenue trends by market and channel.

Daily market-level marketing performance dataset containing ad delivery, traffic, lead generation, booking, completion, revenue, and acquisition efficiency metrics. Includes dimensions for day, week, month, and market, with metrics such as impressions, clicks, ctr, marketing_spend, cpc, leads, cost_per_inquiry, jobs_booked, booking_rate, jobs_completed, conversion_rate, revenue, and mac. Designed for trend analysis, market comparisons, and evaluating the relationship between marketing spend and downstream business outcomes.

Daily technician performance dataset with day, week, month, market, technician name, and active status dimensions. Includes revenue, booked revenue, average ticket, jobs per day, AOV completion rate, total repairs, completed jobs with invoice, repairs per job, cancel rate, completed jobs, and days worked. Use this dataset to analyze technician productivity, revenue generation, repair output, job conversion, cancellations, and workday utilization by technician and market.

Daily VIOC Referral store-level performance dataset containing Day, Month, Week, Store Number, Market, Regional, Area, and Store Manager dimensions, with referral performance and target metrics including Leads, Completed Jobs, Referral Target, Completed Target, and Monthly Referral Target. Use this dataset to analyze daily referral lead volume, completed referral jobs, store-level target attainment, and performance by store, manager, area, region, and market. Best for tracking VIOC referral productivity, comparing store performance, and monitoring progress against daily and monthly referral goals.
